name: Hydrogen refuelling stations
principle: Stations take delivered or on-site hydrogen, compress and cool it, and dispense it at 350 or 700 bar to fuel cell vehicles. IEA counted about 1,300 stations at the end of 2024, 15% more than 2023. China had more than 500 (up 30%) and Europe more than 300. Station counts fell in the US, and Austria's only operator, OMV, announced closure of all stations by September 2025.

performance.metric: hydrogen refuelling stations worldwide at end 2024

source.note: IEA Global Hydrogen Review 2025 (collected in corpus/iea-reports): hydrogen refuelling stations

limitations: Reliability and hydrogen supply problems closed stations in US and Austria
